usedFor: Agendor holds your deals and people, and Gtwy hosts the AI agent that gets a chat request when one changes.

bestTemplate.name: “Deal Won” in Agendor, then “Call AI Agent Instantly” in Gtwy
bestTemplate.why: The request reaches a chosen AI agent in Gtwy with attachments and variables, so a won deal arrives with context.

watchOut: “Update Deal” in Agendor fires on every change, so one deal can send the Gtwy AI agent several chat requests.
